dedupeText: festive snowman holiday album cover snowman winter bokeh holiday script blue and white knitted texture christmas music snowy background the snowman s gaze and smile directed toward the viewer creates an emotional anchor the contrast between the organic knitted textures of the snowman and the sharp geometric typography the blue to white vertical gradient in the background mirrors the snowman s cool toned palette horizontal rules organize the text block to balance the large character on the left combine a high texture winter character on the left with a vertically stacked rule divided typographic block on the right using a script sans serif font pairing over a blue bokeh background

recipe.visualDefinition: A cheerful, textured snowman character positioned on the left, set against a soft-focus blue bokeh background with falling snow effects. The right side features a structured typographic stack using a mix of elegant script and clean sans-serif fonts, framed by horizontal rules.
coreVisualRelationships: The snowman's gaze and smile directed toward the viewer creates an emotional anchor.
The contrast between the organic, knitted textures of the snowman and the sharp, geometric typography.
The blue-to-white vertical gradient in the background mirrors the snowman's cool-toned palette.
Horizontal rules organize the text block to balance the large character on the left.
coreInvariants: A snowman with a knitted hat and scarf as the primary subject.
A deep blue background with white bokeh light circles.
A combination of formal script and modern sans-serif typefaces.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The snowman is large-scale, occupying the left two-thirds of the frame, slightly cropped at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The snowman's bright orange carrot nose and red smile provide a central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the snowman's face, moves right to the large script title, then down through the supporting text blocks.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right and lower right areas are utilized for text placement against the bokeh background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool blues and whites establish the winter theme.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark navy blue is used for secondary text to ensure legibility against the light snow.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright orange (nose) and red (smile) provide warm pops of color.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (bright) whites against mid-to-dark blue saturation.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of high-contrast formal script and geometric sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Script elements feature long, looping ascenders and descenders with variable stroke width.
Sans-serif elements are monolinear with open counters and circular 'O's.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The main title uses a script with a decorative swash on the initial capital letter.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between fluid, decorative script and rigid, modern sans-serif.

preserve: The all-caps styling for secondary text
avoid: Distressed or grunge textures on type

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the elegant, looping quality of the primary script.
Provides the clean, geometric sans-serif look for the supporting text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution image of a cute snowman with a knitted blue and white hat and scarf, smiling with a carrot nose. The background should be a soft blue winter bokeh with falling snow. Leave the right side of the frame relatively clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large white script title in the upper right. Below it, add a horizontal line, then a bold sans-serif title in all caps, followed by another horizontal line. Place additional centered sans-serif text blocks below and at the very bottom of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the snowman's texture clearly visible (knitting, fuzz)?
Are the horizontal rules perfectly aligned with the text blocks?
Is the script font legible against the bokeh background?
Is the color palette limited to blues, whites, and small warm accents?

adjustableVariables: Density of the falling snow effect
Intensity of the blue background gradient
Weight of the horizontal divider lines
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
Any proprietary logos or brand marks

mustAchieve: Tactile feel for the snowman's clothing

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is cut off by the edges.
Check that the script font does not have awkward character collisions.
Verify the snowman's expression remains friendly and festive.
Confirm the background bokeh doesn't distract from the legibility of the small text at the bottom.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-texture winter character on the left with a vertically stacked, rule-divided typographic block on the right, using a script/sans-serif font pairing over a blue bokeh background.
